Effect of serotonin signalling inhibition (KET, VOL) on progenitor proliferation
in fused organoids, lines 112#2 and 28#4. PH3+ counts normalised to VZ Basal
length, outliers removed at the VZ level, values aggregated VZ -> image ->
organoid. All comparisons are at the organoid level on untransformed values.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, tidy = TRUE, fig.asp = 0.5, fig.width = 12,
                      warning = TRUE, message = TRUE)
```

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
source("../helpers/Set_environment.R")
source("../helpers/Set_functions.R")
library(readxl)
set.seed(42)

xlsx_path <- "../rawdata/Quantifications/RO_QUANTIFICATION.xlsx"

keep_treatments <- c("CTRL", "KET", "VOL")
iqr_mult        <- 1.5

line_batch_shapes <- c(
  "112#2_B4" = 16,
  "112#2_B5" = 17,
  "28#4_B3"  = 15,
  "28#4_B4"  = 18,
  "28#4_B5"  = 8
)

# unpaired Welch t-test of each treatment against CTRL within a grouping
welch_vs_ctrl <- function(d, ...) {
  d %>%
    dplyr::group_by(...) %>%
    dplyr::group_modify(function(g, key) {
      ctrl <- g$Value[g$Treatment == "CTRL"]
      g %>%
        dplyr::filter(Treatment != "CTRL") %>%
        dplyr::group_by(Treatment) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(
          n = dplyr::n(),
          p = if (dplyr::n() >= 2 && length(ctrl) >= 2) t.test(Value, ctrl)$p.value else NA_real_,
          .groups = "drop"
        )
    }) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Treatment = droplevels(Treatment)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(label = paste0("n=", n, "\np=",
                             dplyr::if_else(is.na(p), "NA", sprintf("%.2e", p))))
}
```

# Import and join

```{r}
quant <- readxl::read_excel(xlsx_path, sheet = "FUSION_Antagonist_Quant",
                            na = c("", " ", "NA"))
orga  <- readxl::read_excel(xlsx_path, sheet = "FUSION_Antagonist_Organoids",
                            na = c("", " ", "NA"))
df <- quant %>%
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(c(Basal_PH3, Basal_length),
                              ~suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(.x))))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Batch = as.integer(Batch)) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(orga, by = c("Line", "Batch", "Fused", "Treatment", "Image")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Treatment %in% keep_treatments) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = keep_treatments)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Organoid_id = dplyr::if_else(
    is.na(Organoid), NA_character_,
    paste(Line, Batch, Treatment, Organoid, sep = "_")))
```

# Total basal progenitors

```{r}
bp_org <- df %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Organoid_id)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Value = Basal_PH3 / Basal_length) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Line, Batch, Treatment) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(q1 = quantile(Value, 0.25)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(q3 = quantile(Value, 0.75)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(is_outlier = Value < q1 - iqr_mult * (q3 - q1) |
                             Value > q3 + iqr_mult * (q3 - q1)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is_outlier) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Line, Batch, Treatment, Organoid_id, Image) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(img_value = mean(Value), n_VZ = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Line, Batch, Treatment, Organoid_id) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(Value    = mean(img_value),
                   n_images = dplyr::n(),
                   n_VZ     = sum(n_VZ),
                   .groups  = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Line_Batch = paste0(Line, "_B", Batch))

bp_stats <- welch_vs_ctrl(bp_org)

```

```{r}
my_hex <- "#4DBBD5"

base_plot <- ggplot(bp_org, aes(x = Treatment, y = Value)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = my_hex, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(
    aes(shape = Line_Batch),
    width = 0.15,
    size = 0.5,
    stroke = 0.3
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = line_batch_shapes) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.25))) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 5) +
  theme(
    axis.line.x = element_line(),
    axis.line.y = element_line(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.key.size = unit(2, "mm"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 3.5),
    legend.spacing.x = unit(0.5, "mm"),
    legend.margin = margin(t = -2, b = 0, l = 0, r = 0)
  )

```

```{r}
p <- base_plot +
  geom_text(data = bp_stats, aes(x = Treatment, y = Inf, label = label),
            vjust = 1.2, size = 4 / 2.845, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Basal pH3+/ Basal length")
p

ggsave(
  filename = "Figures/Figure4I.png",
  plot = p,
  width = 60, height = 30, units = "mm",
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)
```

p_nolabel
